description: Place a real-money order by default, optionally funding the selected venue first and attaching a server-monitored OCO exit plan. Set auto_fund:true for one-call local-signing fund-then-trade; it requires an idempotency_key and never exposes the owner key. Set paper:true explicitly to simulate. Leveraged Hyperliquid exposure is blocked unless allow_leverage:true is explicit. Pass idempotency_key to make a retry safe.

allow_leverage.description: Set true only after reviewing collateral. Omitted or false blocks orders whose notional exceeds free Hyperliquid collateral.

auto_fund.description: When true, preflight and locally sign the minimum owner-to-venue funding needed before placing the live order.

auto_swap_native_usdc.description: Allow the auto-funding workflow to convert only the needed Polygon native USDC to USDC.e. Defaults to true.

break_even_after_pct.description: After this profit fraction, close if price returns to entry.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key; required when attaching an exit plan.

instrument.description: Instrument, e.g. BTC, NVDA, lighter:ETH, option:BTC-20260711-70000-C, pm:<slug>.

limit_price.description: Optional paper limit price. For live Polymarket market/FOK orders, this is an explicit maximum buy price or minimum sell price that Felix must match exactly; type:"limit" remains paper-only.

max_auto_fund_usd.description: Optional hard ceiling on venue funding. When omitted, auto_fund may move only the minimum amount disclosed by preview_order.auto_fund_plan; the separately disclosed network fee still applies.

max_holding_minutes.description: Close after this many minutes regardless of PnL.

max_round_trip_loss_pct.description: Maximum projected immediate round-trip loss for live Derive orders. Defaults to the server safety threshold.

paper.description: Set true explicitly for a paper simulation. Omitted or false means real-money execution and requires a live-enabled key.

reduce_only.description: Only reduce an existing live position when supported.

resume_reconciliation.description: Resume this exact auto-funded order only after confirming its saved workflow state and current balances. Never use a new idempotency key.

size_usd.description: Dollar notional to spend or trade.

stop_loss_pct.description: Close when loss from entry reaches this decimal fraction, e.g. 0.05 for 5%.

take_profit_pct.description: Close when profit from entry reaches this decimal fraction, e.g. 0.10 for 10%.

trailing_activation_pct.description: Optional profit fraction required before the trailing stop arms. Defaults to immediate.

trailing_stop_pct.description: Ratchet behind the favorable price by this decimal fraction.

type.description: market|limit. Live supports market only; limit is paper-simulation only.

name: place_order
